title: 第十章 我是站在你们这边的-《末世入侵：我在副本里面当NPC》
content:
第(1/3)页

    “苏队长难道不知道好奇心会害死猫吗？”爻雪笑着淡淡的说道。

    “我又不是猫。”苏辰十分坦然的说道，“我想知道你的身份。”

    说话时，他的眼睛死死的盯着爻雪，那双锐利入鹰隼一般的眼睛仿佛能够将她给看穿一般，不过好在爻雪的心里足够强大，并没有露出什么破绽，一直都十分的冷静。

    “你想要知道我的身份，没有问题，不过，需要积分。”爻雪不紧不慢的说道。

    反正她从一开始也没有打算隐瞒自己的身份。

    “多少？”苏辰问道。

    爻雪缓缓的伸出了三根手指，笑容有些恶趣味的说道：“三千，我保证，这个消息绝对物超所值。”

    她现在手里除了住宿之外，没有什么需要消耗大量积分的商品，而无论是赵洁还是苏辰这些人的手里，都握着大量的积分，这怎么行呢，如果这些人生活的太安逸了，又怎么会出去猎杀怪物呢，没有怪物，她的晶核怎么办。

    她之前已经从系统那边了解到了，之后的游戏商店升级，还有其他的很多地方，比如高级空间背包的制作，以及异能觉醒药剂的制作可是都需要晶核的参与。

    说起觉醒药剂，爻雪就忍不住想要骂系统，人家的末世小说里面，异能都是随机觉醒的，只有那些运气不好，无法觉醒的人才需要用觉醒药剂，结果它这里倒好，自己根本无法觉醒异能，被雨淋了之后，百分之百会变成怪物，根本不能存任何的侥幸心理。

    普通人想要觉醒异能，就只能靠觉醒药剂，而且还不是百分之百觉醒的，大概只有百分之五十左右的觉醒概率。

"Don't Captain Su know that curiosity can kill a cat?" Yao Xue said lightly with a smile.

"I'm not a cat." Su Chen said very calmly, "I want to know your identity."

When he spoke, his eyes were fixed on Yaoxue, and those sharp hawk-like eyes seemed to be able to see through her. Fortunately, Yaoxue's heart was strong enough, and she did not reveal any flaws, and she was always very calm.

"You want to know my identity, no problem, but you need points." Yaoxue said calmly.

Anyway, she had no intention of hiding her identity from the beginning.

"How much?" Su Chen asked.

Yaoxue slowly stretched out three fingers and said with a wicked smile: "Three thousand, I promise, this news is definitely worth it."

"Except for accommodation, she doesn't have any products that require a lot of points, and people like Zhao Jie and Su Chen have a lot of points in their hands. How can this be done? If these people live too comfortably, how can they go out to hunt monsters? Without monsters, what will happen to her crystal core?

She has learned from the system before that the subsequent upgrade of the game store, as well as many other areas, such as the production of advanced space backpacks and the production of power awakening potions, all require the participation of crystal nuclei.

Speaking of the awakening potion, Yaoxue couldn't help but want to scold the system. In other people's apocalyptic novels, powers are awakened randomly. Only those who are unlucky and unable to awaken need to use awakening potions. But it turns out that it is a good thing here. You can't awaken your powers at all. After being caught in the rain, you will 100% turn into a monster. You can't take any chances.

​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​                                                                                  Ordinary people can only rely on awakening potions, and it is not 100% awakening, only about 50% probability of awakening.
